name: Mythic Armor Proficiency (Light) (Mythic)
source: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats
book: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

facets.bk: Mythic Options: The Missing Core Feats

body:
You know how to turn light armor to your advantage against any offense, not just attacks designed to harm you.

Prerequisites: Armor Proficiency (light).

Benefit(s): When wearing light armor, add half its non-magic armor bonus to your CMD. You may expend a use of mythic power to also add it to your touch AC for one minute.
